headline: Sunday morning, Day 218, T+7 on the Aug 9 launch — and the machine just answered the question yesterday's brief left open. Aug 15 was hailed as the healthiest scheduling morning since Aug 5-6: the sweep and the brief both fired on cron, in the right order, and the lesson drawn was that the reporting layer was never the bottleneck. Then the two editions since BOTH failed to ship — Aug 15 PM never ran, and Aug 16 AM woke the generator at 01:35Z but never curated, published or logged, leaving a stale May-28 skeleton (Envision Honda, Day 138) sitting on disk as the live data file. One healthy morning was a single swallow, not a spring; W7 is still live, and this PM is a session-driven recovery — the first brief to ship in roughly forty hours. Underneath the machine, the real number has not moved: a live PM read of the mailbox runs from:facebookmail.com OR from:meta.com across the whole account and comes back EMPTY — no ad review, no billing receipt, no lead, seven days past T-0. Zero IRS at 49 days, zero Mercedes at 37. The only thing the inbox has produced since yesterday is another PhantomBuster marketing drip (Aug 15 09:02Z, still unread) pushing 40%-off Auto-Connect that 'ends Aug 18' — a discount on the exact tool shape W14 rejects, and the correct move is to keep ignoring it. W15 — launched, or held to a named date — is now four mornings unwritten, and the last founder decision recorded anywhere in this company is still Aug 5, eleven days ago. Every gate on this board assumes an answer to a question nobody has written down.
